conflicts.statement: The duty reporting 12:40Z on 11 Sep and releasing 04:51Z on 12 Sep runs 16h11, which is 3h11 beyond the 13h planning maximum.
options: Drop the ARN night pairing (MD590/MD455) from the day
Split the four sectors across two duty periods
Re-crew the return sector at ARN

conflicts.statement: With 16h11 on duty plus 55 min commute each end, only 5h59 of the surrounding 24 hours is ever free, so 7h of sleep in that 24h cannot be reached however sleep is arranged.
options: Shorten the duty so at least 7h of off-duty time falls in the day
Trade the duty for a two-sector pattern
Accept the shortfall and protect a long sleep before and after

conflicts.statement: The same 16h11 duty leaves at most 5h59 free in any 24h window, well short of the 7h30 you want.
options: Ask for the duty to be shortened
Plan a recovery sleep on the 12 Sep day off

derivations.method: Not derived from an offset: the ENT (Entrenamiento simulador o tierra) row prints 08:00 in the Reporte column and 16:00 in Fin. Per the standing rule, training report time is the stated start of the window with no reporting offset applied, so 08:00 local MAD was converted directly.
